name: chronos
description: Check Codex degradation, approval amplification, rule health, and advisory read-worker coordination.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect Codex health and govern bounded workers.
interface.longDescription: Check Windows process, memory, disk, diagnostic-log, token-quota, approval persistence, permission-rule, reviewer-escalation, lineage, fork-context, and rollout health, then coordinate bounded read-only Codex workers using runtime model discovery, canonical workspace identity, advisory leases, privacy limits, and coordinator verification.
defaultPrompt: Use Chronos to inspect current Codex resource health.
Use Chronos to recommend the safest response to current Codex lag.
Use Chronos to explain token pressure or coordinate one bounded read-only worker.
